fields.statement: At e7e52b13 ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/build-verifier-checkout: PASS. Read the diffs of 920738fb (session start copies the actor record change set into r.dir via copyChangeSetLog, same files and IDs) and e7e52b13 (the merge step that closes review finding f1). make check: fmt, vet and all go tests pass; self-check fails only on stale rendered actor files from the run's own chore record commits, not from this leaf.
